CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mindatlas_reject_plan10_immutable_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'MINDATLAS_PLAN10_IMMUTABLE: % on % is not allowed',
                TG_OP, TG_TABLE_NAME
                USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation';
        END;
        $function$
